## AI Deployment Intelligence Center
Live Stable-vs-Canary telemetry, AI contextual analysis, governed decisioning and deterministic safety controls.

## AI Intelligence Snapshot
Cluster, model, freshness, risk, confidence and trend for the current AI analysis cycle.

## AI Governance & Decision Safety
The LLM recommends; deterministic governance validates, constrains and safely controls deployment actions.

## Canary Health at a Glance
Application and infrastructure signals used to determine whether Canary degradation is isolated or correlated.

## AI Risk Calculation
Base Risk = Latency + Error + CPU + Memory + Pod Health + Trend. Final Risk = Base Risk + AI Context Adjustment.

## AI Interpretation & Recommended Action
This is the high-level AI explanation of what is wrong, whether signals are correlated, and what the rollout should do next.

## AI Explainability Flow
Discover → Baseline → Collect → Compare → Trend → Correlate → Risk → Decide. This is a visible process view, not hidden model chain-of-thought.

## AI Findings
Red/orange findings require attention; green findings confirm healthy supporting signals.

## Stable vs Canary Telemetry
Stable is the live baseline. These views show whether Canary degradation is isolated or accompanied by error, CPU, memory or pod-health pressure.
